newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA PUTS NATIONAL GAMES ONLINE FOR FIRST TIME.
newsitem.headline: CHINA PUTS NATIONAL GAMES ONLINE FOR FIRST TIME.

text.p: Chinese sports authorities have ventured into cyberspace by putting information on a major sports event on the Internet for the first time, officials said on Tuesday.

Real-time results, schedules and information on competitors and venues for the Eighth National Games, would be available online throughout the competition, which will be held in Shanghai from October 12 to 14, an organiser said by telephone.
It was the first time that information on a major sports event organised in China would be distributed on the worldwide computer network, he said.
Readers of Chinese with software for the characters in use on the mainland can access the information at www.nationalgames.op.cn.
